name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IITB)

reviews.author: Aarav Mehta
reviews.comment: Unmatched research culture, world-class faculty, and the campus life at Powai is unforgettable.

reviews.author: Sneha Patil
reviews.comment: Academic curriculum is rigorous, but placements and peer learning are absolutely worth it.

reviews.author: Rohan Deshmukh
reviews.comment: Mood Indigo and Techfest are amazing. Facilities are top notch, highly recommended.

overview: Established in 1958, IIT Bombay is one of the premier public engineering universities in Asia, famous for its cutting-edge research, tech innovations, and highly competitive admissions.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IITD)

reviews.author: Amit Sharma
reviews.comment: Located in the heart of Delhi, providing high corporate exposure and excellent academic guidance.

reviews.author: Priya Sen
reviews.comment: Excellent coding culture. The competitive atmosphere drives you to perform at your best.

reviews.author: Vikram Malhotra
reviews.comment: Stellar campus life, state-of-the-art incubation centre, and great startup support.

overview: IIT Delhi is a top-ranked institute of national importance located in Hauz Khas, New Delhi. It is globally recognized for training leaders and producing groundbreaking scientific work.

name: National Institute of Technology Karnataka (NITK)

reviews.author: Karthik Gowda
reviews.comment: Only college in India with its own private beach! Campus life and peer culture are absolute gold.

reviews.author: Anjali Hegde
reviews.comment: Awesome placements, especially in CS/IT branches. Hostels are comfortable and food is decent.

reviews.author: Srinivas Rao
reviews.comment: The technical clubs (IEEE, ACM) are highly active. Great opportunities for core and IT jobs.

overview: NITK Surathkal is one of the leading technical institutions in India, beautifully situated along the shores of the Arabian Sea in Karnataka.

name: Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS) Pilani

reviews.author: Aditya Birla
reviews.comment: Zero attendance policy gives you maximum freedom to pursue coding, startups, or extra-curriculars.

reviews.author: Meera Sharma
reviews.comment: The Practice School (PS-I and PS-II) internships provide amazing industry experience and PPOs.

reviews.author: Yash Vardhan
reviews.comment: Stellar alumni network. Pilani campus has an unmatched vintage, cozy feel.

overview: BITS Pilani is a prestigious private deemed university in Rajasthan, legendary for its unique zero-attendance policy, strong alumni network, and excellent placement records.

name: Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT)

reviews.author: Prakash Kumar
reviews.comment: Huge infrastructure, massive student crowd, and excellent placement opportunities for hard-working students.

reviews.author: Divya Nair
reviews.comment: Campus rules are strict regarding curfew timings, but the academic freedom and labs are top-notch.

reviews.author: Ranjith Balan
reviews.comment: Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS) lets you choose your own teachers and timetables.

overview: Established in 1984, VIT Vellore is a leading private deemed university in Tamil Nadu, recognized as an Institution of Eminence by the Government of India.

name: Manipal Institute of Technology (MIT)

reviews.author: Rahul Shenoy
reviews.comment: Manipal offers an amazing student-friendly town experience. Best place to grow personally and professionally.

reviews.author: Keerthi Prasad
reviews.comment: Brilliant academic curriculum. Modern infrastructure, and excellent library facility.

reviews.author: Tushar Kapoor
reviews.comment: Hostels are like hotels and the college atmosphere is very cosmopolitan. Absolutely loved my time here.

overview: MIT Manipal is a constituent college of MAHE, a highly respected private deemed university in Karnataka, known for its premium lifestyle and strong tech curriculum.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IITKGP)

reviews.author: Siddharth Roy
reviews.comment: Largest campus in India! Infinite options for sports, clubs, and research. Truly life-transforming.

reviews.author: Riya Das
reviews.comment: Illumination festival (Illu) and Spring Fest are awesome. Placements are solid every single year.

reviews.author: Ankit Ghosh
reviews.comment: Highly skilled peers. Teachers are legends in their fields. Research funding is exceptional.

overview: IIT Kharagpur was the first of the IITs to be established (in 1951), and has the largest campus, offering a vast array of disciplines including law and management.

name: COEP Technological University (COEP)

reviews.author: Pranav Joshi
reviews.comment: One of the oldest colleges in Asia. Rich legacy and unbeatable corporate connect in Pune.

reviews.author: Sayali Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Campus is situated beautifully along the Mula river. Academic reputation is highly respected in the industry.

reviews.author: Abhishek More
reviews.comment: Outstanding technical clubs, like the Satellite Team and Baja SAE. Pure practical learning.

overview: Established in 1854, COEP in Pune is the third oldest engineering college in Asia, offering a rich historical legacy combined with modern technical programs.

name: R.V. College of Engineering (RVCE)

courses.name: M.Tech VLSI Design and Embedded Systems

reviews.author: Nikith R
reviews.comment: If you want placements in Bangalore, RVCE is next only to IISc. Insane amount of core and software companies visit.

reviews.author: Shruti Murthy
reviews.comment: Academics are strict, but the campus location on Mysore Road and exposure to IT hub is top-tier.

reviews.author: Vinayak Naik
reviews.comment: Unbelievable coding culture and very supportive senior community.

overview: RVCE Bangalore is a highly prestigious self-financing engineering institution in Karnataka, famous for its stellar placement rates in Bangalore's tech ecosystem.

name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

reviews.author: Arun Kumar
reviews.comment: Kattankulathur campus is massive! Very diverse student crowd from all over India.

reviews.author: Simranjeet Kaur
reviews.comment: Lots of opportunities to participate in research and international exchanges, but class strength is huge.

reviews.author: Vikas Krishnan
reviews.comment: Brilliant facilities, high-end labs, and clean hostels.

overview: SRM Chennai is a massive private deemed university with a modern campus in Kattankulathur, offering excellent educational amenities and wide recruiter reach.

name: Jadavpur University (JU)

reviews.author: Debabrata Roy
reviews.comment: Unbelievably low fees (under 10,000 total!) with average packages rivaling top NITs. The ROI is unmatched globally.

reviews.author: Shreyasi Banik
reviews.comment: JU promotes a free-thinking environment and deep academic independence. Top-tier laboratory support.

reviews.author: Sayan Das
reviews.comment: A premium hub in the East. Culture, debate clubs, and placement stats are absolutely stellar.

overview: Established in 1955, Jadavpur University is a premier state-funded public university in Kolkata, famous for its exceptionally low fees and exceptionally high return on investment.

name: Delhi Technological University (DTU)

reviews.author: Sandeep Tanwar
reviews.comment: Formerly known as DCE, it has an immense brand value, a sprawling green campus, and a legendary coding culture.

reviews.author: Aakriti Gupta
reviews.comment: Corporate exposure in NCR is fantastic. High placement rates in top product companies.

reviews.author: Pranav Bajaj
reviews.comment: Engifest is the biggest fest in Delhi! Awesome student facilities and great sports complex.

overview: Formerly Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), DTU is a premier public university in Rohini, New Delhi, renowned for its strong historical background and top corporate recruiting.

name: Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT)

reviews.author: Rohit Verma
reviews.comment: Amazing coding crowd. Very strong competitive programming community.

reviews.author: Deepika Singh
reviews.comment: Spacious campus in Dwarka. Excellent placements, comparable to top IITs.

reviews.author: Abhay Saxena
reviews.comment: Very strict academic rules on attendance, but the placement numbers make up for it.

overview: NSUT, formerly NSIT, is a premier state public university in Dwarka, Delhi. It is highly sought after for its exceptional placements in technology sectors.

name: Symbiosis Institute of Technology (SIT)

courses.name: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

reviews.author: Tanmay Sawant
reviews.comment: Lavale campus is extremely beautiful, located on top of a hill. Great infrastructure and liberal crowd.

reviews.author: Radhika Sen
reviews.comment: Decent placements for CS/IT. The academic pressure is moderate, giving time for hobbies.

reviews.author: Gaurav Shinde
reviews.comment: Sports facilities are top-notch (swimming pool, gym, etc.). Excellent campus food.

overview: SIT Pune is a prominent constituent institute of Symbiosis International University, famous for its picturesque hill-top campus in Lavale and modern technical courses.

name: SVKM's NMIMS Mukesh Patel School of Technology

reviews.author: Aniket Sanghavi
reviews.comment: Located right in Vile Parle, Mumbai. Excellent exposure to corporate culture and great internships.

reviews.author: Mansi Shah
reviews.comment: Strict rules about 80% attendance, but the corporate placements and infrastructure are fantastic.

reviews.author: Deepesh Mehta
reviews.comment: The MBA Tech course is highly industry-relevant, giving you both technical and business knowledge.

overview: NMIMS MPSTME is a premier private engineering school in Mumbai, known for its strong corporate connect, city campus vibe, and unique integrated dual-degree programs.

name: PES University (PESU)

reviews.author: Supriya M
reviews.comment: Academic rigor is very high, but the placement opportunities are easily among the best in South India.

reviews.author: Nikhil Murthy
reviews.comment: Regular assessments keep you on your toes, but you are very well trained for placements.

reviews.author: Rakshith Shetty
reviews.comment: Stellar campus facilities (especially the auditorium and sports fields). Outstanding coding groups.

overview: PES University, located on Ring Road in Bangalore, is a top-tier private university in Karnataka, popular for its strict academics and outstanding CS placements.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IITM)

courses.name: B.Tech Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering

reviews.author: Vignesh Raj
reviews.comment: Ranked #1 by NIRF for years, and it absolutely lives up to the reputation. The research park is stellar.

reviews.author: Meenakshi Sundaram
reviews.comment: Beautiful campus inside a national park, with deers roaming around. Coding culture is unmatched.

reviews.author: Aditya Krishnan
reviews.comment: Outstanding student tech teams (Hyperloop, Formula Student). Unbelievable corporate connect.

overview: IIT Madras is a legendary public engineering university in Chennai, consistently ranked as the top engineering college in India by NIRF, hosting a renowned research park.

name: PSG College of Technology

reviews.author: Siddharth P
reviews.comment: Highly respected in the industrial sector. The sandwich courses provide outstanding factory floor experience.

reviews.author: Kavya Murugan
reviews.comment: Academics and laboratory work are rigorous. Placements in core manufacturing and IT are stellar.

reviews.author: Manoj Kumar
reviews.comment: PSG has an outstanding brand name in Tamil Nadu. Highly supportive alumni network.

overview: PSG College of Technology, established in 1951 in Coimbatore, is a premier private-aided engineering college, famous for its heavy industrial collaborations and practical sandwich courses.

name: Heritage Institute of Technology (HIT)

reviews.author: Aritra Sen
reviews.comment: The campus is beautifully designed and very clean. Decent facilities and library.

reviews.author: Priyanka Roy
reviews.comment: Mass recruitments are the main option, but if you do coding on your own, you can clear off-campus rounds easily.

reviews.author: Rahul Banerjee
reviews.comment: Faculty members are supportive and helpful. Great labs and standard infrastructure.

overview: Heritage Institute of Technology is a prominent private engineering college in Kolkata, West Bengal, recognized for its green campus and steady placement history.

name: Jamia Hamdard University

reviews.author: Saad Khan
reviews.comment: Excellent pharmacy department (ranked #1 in India!). Engineering departments are decent and growing.

reviews.author: Fiza Shaikh
reviews.comment: Campus is located inside South Delhi. Lots of green cover and peaceful atmosphere.

reviews.author: Manish Gupta
reviews.comment: Good library facility and decent computer science labs. Average placements.

overview: Jamia Hamdard is a reputable deemed university in Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi, famous globally for its pharmaceutical research and growing tech division.
